beats: On roads I drive almost every day, the guide runs out of new places and goes quiet.
Now it replays a story from an earlier drive instead — like a guide repeating a tale rather than falling silent.
A place only replays after sixteen hours of quiet, and a genuinely new spot always jumps ahead of it.
A separate fix also stopped town-wide stories from starting two point five kilometers early — now they wait until I'm actually there.
